rows.description: 280+ free n8n automation templates — ready-to-use workflows for Gmail, Telegram, Slack, Discord, WhatsApp, Google Drive, Notion, OpenAI, and more. AI agents, RAG   chatbots, email automation, social media, DevOps, and document processing. The largest open-source n8n template collection.
